status.description: status is the EKS status, such as ACTIVE or UPDATING.

version.description: version is the Kubernetes minor version, such as "1.33".

upgradePolicy.description: upgradePolicy is the EKS support type, STANDARD or EXTENDED.

healthIssues.description: healthIssues are the control-plane issues that EKS reports.

incomplete.description: incomplete is true when part of the row could not be read. The failures of the row are in the failures list of the document.

Cluster.description: Cluster is one EKS cluster. A key is left out when its data was not read: a row that could not be read at all has its name, its region, and incomplete.

name.description: name identifies the item. For a Region failure it is the region.

cluster.description: cluster is the cluster that the item belongs to.

operation.description: operation is the IAM action that failed, such as "eks:DescribeNodegroup".

retryable.description: retryable reports whether the same command, run again with no other change, may succeed.

error.description: error is one line of text for people. Do not parse it; use Reason.

awsErrorCode.description: awsErrorCode is the AWS API error code, such as AccessDeniedException, when AWS answered.

updateId.description: updateId is the EKS update ID, for a failure of a started update.

Failure.description: Failure is one item that refresh could not read, or one action that it tried and that did not complete.

FailureKind.description: FailureKind is the type of item a Failure is about.

Failures.description: Failures is the failure list of a document. A nil list encodes as [], so a document always has its failures key as a list.

Issue.description: Issue is a health issue that EKS reports for a resource.

publicAccess.description: publicAccess and PrivateAccess say how the API server endpoint can be reached.

Network.description: Network is the VPC configuration of a cluster.

Reason.description: Reason is why a Failure happened, from a closed set. A script branches on it. A later release may add a reason, so a consumer must accept a value it does not know.

kmsKeyArn.description: kmsKeyArn is the key that encrypts secrets. It is left out when secrets are not encrypted with a KMS key.

logTypes.description: logTypes are the enabled control-plane log types.

Security.description: Security is the security configuration of a cluster.

apiVersion.description: The version of the document contract.

skippedRegions.description: skippedRegions are the regions of a default sweep that are closed to these credentials. They are not failures. The key is left out when the regions were named.

failures.description: Every failure of the run: the items that refresh could not read and the actions that did not complete. The list is sorted by kind, region, cluster, name, and operation. It is [] when there are no failures.

title: ClusterList
description: The document that `refresh cluster list -o json` prints. -o yaml prints the same structure.
